body:
## Pull request overview

This pull request fixes two critical issues in the ObjectUI demo/development environment: non-functional `userFilters` in ListView and missing admin role for guest users when authentication is disabled.

**Changes:**
- Added AST-format filter evaluation support to ValueDataSource to handle array-based filter conditions from ListView's userFilters
- Assigned admin role to guest user when auth is disabled, enabling access to all management UI features in demo environments
- Added comprehensive test coverage for AST filter operators and guest user role assignment

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 5 out of 5 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/core/src/adapters/ValueDataSource.ts | Implemented `matchesASTFilter()` function to evaluate array-format AST filters with support for comparison operators (`=`, `!=`, `>`, etc.), logical operators (`and`, `or`), and string operations (`contains`, `startswith`) |
| packages/core/src/adapters/__tests__/ValueDataSource.test.ts | Added 10 comprehensive tests covering AST filter evaluation with various operators, logical combinations, and edge cases |
| packages/auth/src/AuthProvider.tsx | Updated guest user initialization to include `role: 'admin'` when auth is disabled, with explanatory comment |
| packages/auth/src/__tests__/AuthProvider.disabled.test.tsx | Added test to verify admin role assignment to guest user |
| ROADMAP.md | Documented completion of userFilters AST filter fix and guest user admin role fix |
</details>
